title: Detective Mummy Dragon
desc: When the mummy dragon embarks on a killing spree, terrorising everyone, the empress appoints Dee Renji to tackle the problem.

title: Loveshhuda
desc: Gaurav ends up sleeping with Pooja at his own bachelor party. Even though the matter is soon forgotten and the two go on with their lives, they meet again years later for Pooja's bachelorette party.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.

title: Vikramadithyan
desc: Two close friends face various hurdles as they navigate the complexities of life while striving to realise their shared dreams.

title: Krishna Ki Love Story
desc: Krishna falls in love with Mahalakshmi whose brother is a henchman of a don. During a gang war, he entrusts the responsibility of children to Krishna and asks him to return them to their parents.

title: Khiladi
desc: A group of four friends decide to play a prank involving the fake kidnapping of one of them and asking for ransom from her father. However, things become complicated when she actually ends up dead.
